scope: Initial feature_rows and feature_rows_shared candidates only; any later helper extraction requires fresh review.

findings.finding: Amplitude-weighted full-bank coefficients and derivatives are now formed and checked before multiplication by carried RC state. This changes accepted finite input behavior: a zero carried state can make baseline endpoint and gradient zero while intermediate candidate feature derivatives overflow.

findings.finding: Algebraic equality is not bitwise equality. Full-row accumulation reorders state/amplitude multiplication and adds zero derivatives. Uniform behavior and accumulated error are not established by the source identity.
findings.disposition: Run finite range/boundary and short paired stream controls for each revised candidate; do not infer lifetime bounds.

algebra_review.row_index: 3+(2*b+forced)*13+j with full=1 matches free/forced block b and 13 cardinal poles
algebra_review.raw_to_whitened_derivative: feature gives raw chart derivative; transported final loop multiplies by scale exactly once
algebra_review.likelihood: feature callers for likelihood retain full=0 reduced 3-pole projection

lifetime_review.result: No overlap defect found for declared serialized current callers
lifetime_review.argument: transported only receives c->trial; c->point and externally owned carried responses are distinct. scratch.fit.d aliases scratch.y, but previous step has already copied y to delta. scalar transports before acquiring variance lease, and variance overwrites all y entries before root_row copies them. factor is separate and unchanged. Calls are serialized; no interrupt/concurrent ownership guarantee is added.
